import java.util.*;

public class Solution {
    private static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long q = sc.nextLong();
        
        long cnt = q - p + 1;
        long odd = (p % 2 == 1) ? (cnt + 1) / 2 : cnt / 2;
        long even = cnt - odd;
        
        long total = n * m;
        
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(odd + even, total));
        } else {
            long result = (modPow(odd + even, total) + modPow(even - odd, total)) % MOD;
            result = (result * modPow(2, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    private static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        if (base < 0) base += MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
